name: Mysterious Girl
source: A girl who distributes flyers with advertising of a small store selling Christmas Cakes. While a chance encounter with Jun'ichi she calls herself Santa Claus, and having learned about the problems with his beloved, she promises that everything will be fine, because the Christmas dreams are coming true. This girl looks suspiciously similar to Aisia and voiced by same seiyu.
